prompts.emperor-impact-sequence: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production RPG VFX SPRITE SHEET: exact 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 equal square cells in a landscape 4:3 canvas. Reference is the imperial golden impact's color and energy language. All 12 cells are one CHRONOLOGICAL ANIMATION of an imperial golden arrowless impact burst, no objects/characters/UI/text/grid lines. Row-major order left to right then down. Fixed center at cell center, constant camera, consistent scale across frames. Frame1 tiny sharp ignition glint. Frame2 condensed ivory-gold core with two curved sparks. Frame3 sudden star-shaped outward cracking flash. Frame4 bright peak radial gold shards and small ruby embers. Frame5 expanding thin broken light ring, core opens. Frame6 elongated fragments spread outward, core dims. Frame7 fragments visibly BREAK APART into smaller particles, not just scaling same image. Frame8 curling fine gold trails and drifting ruby pin sparks, faint dissipating wisps. Frame9 sparse irregular short shards. Frame10 tiny cooling gold embers. Frame11 barely visible two drifting pinpricks. Frame12 almost fully faded residual dust. Every frame physically different silhouette and fragmentation, smooth logical progression, preserve empty gaps and readable particle shapes. Crisp highly detailed painterly fantasy VFX. All effects confined inside central 76 percent of their own cell with equal generous transparent gutters, no overlap or cropped rays. Genuine alpha transparent background everywhere outside effects, no black rectangle, no checkerboard. No UI assets or frame ornaments.
prompts.emperor-crest: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D RPG battlefield visual-effect sprite, a single imperial crest hovering behind an allied formation. Create an imposing luminous GOLD SUN AND CROWN sigil: a tall five-point angular imperial crown above a radiant sun core, two elegant upward laurel branches and a few sharp light rays, tiny ruby-red accents. Luxurious polished gold, ivory-gold radiance and dark amber dimensional relief inspired by fantasy emperor armor. Symmetric, crisp, richly painted collectible RPG VFX, clear silhouette at 220 pixels, no character, no armor body, no rectangular plaque, no UI frame, no text, no letters, no scene. The sun core is open/luminous rather than a solid opaque disk. Isolated centered crest with a soft restrained gold aura and transparent gaps between crown and laurel. Entire design inside the central 80 percent of a square canvas, generous transparent margin. Genuine alpha transparent background, not black, no checkerboard, no backdrop.

All negative space and background genuinely alpha transparent. Do not bake a black background or checkerboard.
